verdict.rationale: Kong documents API authentication and authorization (JWT, OAuth, ACLs) and a Dev Portal where developers manage their own credentials. Konnect also claims you can define entitlements for agents, MCP servers and tools. Together these imply scoped consumer credentials that an agent could use, but nothing explicitly describes issuing least-privilege credentials for an agent. Missing for 10: explicit docs on per-agent scoped or least-privilege credential issuance, scope or permission granularity details, credential expiry and rotation for agent use, and hands-on or independent corroboration.
